The first commit is stuck. Your git config has `commit.gpgsign = true`, so git is waiting for the GPG signing step, most likely a passphrase prompt (pinentry) that I can't answer from here. Nothing has been committed yet. The setup files are staged and the other three files are untouched.

I won't turn signing off to get around it. Once signing works, this is the plan:

1. `chore: set up TypeScript project with pnpm`: package.json, lockfile, pnpm-workspace.yaml, tsconfig.json, .env.example
2. `feat(agent): add npm package advisor agent`: agent.ts
3. `docs: add architecture and decision log`: architecture.md, decisions.md

I left out the `Co-Authored-By` trailer because your CLAUDE.md says you're the only author.

Checks: `tsc --noEmit` passes. The project has no lint script and no tests, so those two gates had nothing to run.

**What the project is:** Mekiki is a command-line agent that recommends npm packages. `agent.ts` runs a tool-calling loop through the OpenAI SDK, pointed at the `aicredits.in` base URL. It has two tools:
- `search_packages` pulls 25 npm search results, sorts them by weekly downloads and keeps the top 8. npm ranks search results by text match, so popular packages can fall outside a short result list.
- `get_package_info` fetches `/latest` (5 KB, compared with 5 MB for the full package document) and runs an exact-name search at the same time to get the publish date and download count.

Tool calls from one model turn run in parallel. The loop stops after 8 model turns, and Neatlogs traces each run as a workflow, then the agent, then one span per model call and tool call. `decisions.md` records the reasons and rejected options well. One gap is still open on purpose: an npm error status crashes the whole run instead of going back to the model.

**Next action (about 1 minute):** look for a pinentry or passphrase window on your screen and enter the passphrase. If there isn't one, run `! gpg --list-secret-keys` here so we can see whether your signing key is available. Then tell me to retry and I'll make all three commits.
